question: What dark form is accessed by resorting to the abode of the yogini?
premises: One resorts to the place of the yogini
A dark form is encountered there
That form is black in color
inference: By resorting to the yogini's abode, one accesses a dark, black-colored form.
plain_english: Having resorted to the abode of the yogini, one encounters the dark, black-colored form.
